summary: Verified Canvas.jsx null-ref crash fix on DEMO-01 project. Executed heavy stress: 8 rapid drag/flick cycles + abrupt release outside-node per node across 5 nodes (40 drag sessions), 6 rapid resize cycles on the resize-handle, 8 rapid pan cycles on empty canvas background. Registered page.on('pageerror') and console error listeners. Regression: added scene node (add-node-scene), properties panel opened, saved (button showed 'Đã lưu'), reloaded page — canvas re-hydrated cleanly and node count increased from 5 to 6 (persistence confirmed).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct: onMouseMove now captures `const d = drag.current` / destructures `resize.current` / `const p = pan.current` before the setNodes/setView functional updater, eliminating the null-ref race with onMouseUp.
Canvas.jsx is large (~840+ lines); consider splitting node-editor panel, resize/drag/pan handlers, and toolbar into separate modules for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Added one 'Scene mới' node to DEMO-01 canvas via add-node-scene, saved. Post-reload nodes: 6 (was 5).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Draggable node selector is `[data-testid^="node-"]` where testid == `node-<nodeId>`; filter out non-node testids like node-editor, node-title-input, node-color-*, node-media-*, node-lock-btn, node-delete-btn, node-media-input, node-text-input. Resize handle: [data-testid='resize-handle']. Canvas board: [data-testid='canvas-board']. Save btn: [data-testid='canvas-save-btn']. Login page fills email/password and redirects to '/'.
rca of the issue: React batches functional state updaters; setNodes(prev => prev.map(n => n.id === drag.current.id ...)) queued during rapid mousemove could execute after onMouseUp had already set drag.current=null, throwing 'Cannot read properties of null (reading id)'. Fix captures ref values into locals before enqueuing the updater. Verified: after ~54 stress interactions, 0 pageerrors and 0 console errors.
